semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Singway Technology primarily focuses on waste management and recycling, which supports semiconductor manufacturing but does not directly supply semiconductor components or materials.
summary: Singway Technology Co., Ltd specializes in precious metal recycling and wastewater treatment systems, particularly for the semiconductor industry. The company offers services such as industrial waste and wastewater treatment, as well as metal material regeneration, catering to the needs of the PCB, optoelectronic, and semiconductor sectors.
capabilities: Precious metal recycling from optoelectronic semiconductor parts
Wastewater treatment system development using non-cyanide methods
Industrial waste management and reclamation services

regional_presence.Taiwan: Singway Technology is the second largest precious metal processing company in Taiwan and has established a full-process plant for wastewater treatment.
